calculation_handling.description: Transition: Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not prevent a project whose zoning certificate request was filed on or before the cut-off date.
Permit stage: building permit plans must substantially match the plans approved with the zoning certificate.
The project must comply, or be amended to comply, with 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5 and finally approved minor variances.
Defines a request for zoning certificate as one meeting Article I of Municipal Code Chapter 363.

200.15.15.2(1).explanation: Transition rule: Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not stop a project whose zoning certificate request was filed on or before May 26, 2017, in the circumstances of 200.15.15.2(2).

200.15.15.2(2).explanation: Once a zoning certificate is issued for a qualifying project, a building permit may be issued if its plans substantially match the approved plans and the project complies, or is amended to comply, with 200.15.15.4, 200.15.15.5 and any finally approved minor variances.

200.15.15.2(3).explanation: A request for zoning certificate means one that meets Article I of Chapter 363 of the City of Toronto Municipal Code.
